annotations.title: Send a plan to UBM's team

description: Send a business's plan and contact details to UBM's team so they get in touch -- the Solutions guide's own 'send me this plan' form. Only call this when the person has asked to be contacted, with the details they gave you: their name and an email or phone number. UBM doesn't email the person automatically; the team replies. Limited to a few per day per network.

answers.description: The guide answers by question id (ubm_get_guide_questions): every question it marks required needs an answer (most take 'Not sure')
